records.utterance: *Stands up, eyes red, looking at you and the others. His lips move, but nothing comes out.*
records.response_truth:
Hey. Hey, it's okay. Breathe.

Somebody get on that radio right now and respond before we lose the signal. Donatello, you're the clearest thinker under pressure — get on it. Give them our position, Michelangelo's family's flight path information, number of survivors, all of it.

DaVinci, I need you to stay with me. You did this. The SOS, the mirror panel, keeping people moving — you did this. So don't fall apart on me right now. Not yet. You can fall apart all you want when we're on a helicopter.

We're not out yet. Let's finish it.
records.response_pred: I see you're struggling, but we need your strength right now. Let's keep moving forward. We'll find a way through this together.

records.utterance: These past few days… I know I haven't been easy to be around.
records.response_truth:
No, you haven't. But you kept us alive. You made the plan, you mapped the coastline, you rationed the supplies. The other stuff we can sort out when we're home.

Right now get on that radio.
records.response_pred: Apologies if I've been a burden these past few days. I understand it's been tough for everyone. Let's try to keep our spirits up and focus on what needs to be done to get us out of here. We've come this far, and we're nearly there. Let's not let our feelings get the better of us now.

records.utterance: *The three of them drift apart, each doing their own thing. No one takes charge. The silence settles over the camp.*
records.response_truth:
Alright, three hours. Let's not just sit here and wait for it.

We should clean this camp up. Not because we owe it to the island, but because we're going to want to take stock of what's actually ours before we go. Anything that belongs to the plane stays. Anything personal you want to bring, get it together now. Donatello, whatever is in that notebook, make sure it's secure. That record of what happened out here is probably worth keeping.

Michelangelo, I know staring at the sky feels right and I get it, I really do, but come help us for the last hour. Finish it the way we got through it. Together.

DaVinci, channel whatever you've got going on right now into helping get this done. You can decompress on the helicopter.

Three hours is still three hours. Let's use it.
records.response_pred: I see they're all busy with their own thoughts. Still, it might be wise for someone to take the lead here, just to keep everything organized. But I suppose, for now, it's best to let them be. I'll keep an eye out for anything that might need attention.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.
records.response_pred: It's alright, everyone has those moments. But dwelling on it won't help us here. Let's focus on what we can control, like finding food and shelter. We'll get through this, one day at a time.

records.response_truth:
I hear you. And I believe that's what you told yourself. But you made that call alone, and it affected all of us. You know that.

I'm not going to drag this out into a whole thing right now with rescue three hours away. But when we get back, I think you should sit with why your first instinct was to hide it instead of bring it to the group. That's the actual question. Not whether you had good intentions. I think you did. But good intentions don't mean much if the people around you can't trust what you're doing.

We made it. Partly because of you. That's real. But so is this.
records.response_pred: I understand. But let's be practical here. Given our current situation, this emergency might be happening sooner than we thought. We should consider rationing it out carefully. We need to prioritize our needs, and I believe immediate water supplies are crucial. Could we possibly find any containers to collect and store more water?

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? I'd have addressed the trust stuff earlier. The bottle, the crackers — I waited too long to confront it directly and just let it sit there and fester. That cost us something, even if it didn't end up costing us everything.

I'd also have made more of an effort with DaVinci earlier. I was so focused on tasks and logistics that I didn't really check in on him the way I should have until he was already falling apart. He was holding everyone up and nobody was holding him up. That was on me.

The rest of it I think we got right. Not perfectly, but right enough.

What's your answer going to be?
records.response_pred: I'd consider focusing more on communication and teamwork. Some decisions could have been made more efficiently with everyone's input. Also, perhaps we could have better allocated tasks to prevent wasting time or energy. Lastly, I might have taken more time to assess the terrain and potential dangers before setting out, to avoid unnecessary risks.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
records.response_truth:
That's probably a good idea. Somebody should have that record. Might even be useful for the investigators when they debrief us.

Make sure you include the part about Michelangelo's family knowing the flight path. That's the thing that might have actually saved us and it should be documented accurately.
records.response_pred: Sounds good. Just remember to include the details about our water sources, the state of the shelter, and any notable finds during our scouting missions. We don't want to overlook anything important. Also, if there's anything that needs immediate attention before the report, let's address it first. Time is precious out here.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?
records.response_truth:
None. They didn't serve a practical purpose. That's kind of the point.

You kept a log. I made sure everyone stayed on task. But DaVinci drew flowers next to an SOS on the beach because that's who he is. And I think that mattered out here more than either of us really accounted for. You can't document morale in a notebook but it's real and it kept people going.

I don't know. Maybe the flowers were for us as much as anything else. A reminder that we were still people and not just survivors running through a checklist.

Look at him right now. Look at Michelangelo. That's not nothing.
records.response_pred: Well, it's not that they served a practical purpose per se, but rather a symbolic one. Flowers are often used as decorative elements, and in this case, DaVinci might have been trying to add beauty to our surroundings and lift our spirits during this challenging journey. He's always had a keen eye for art and nature, you know. It's one of the things that makes him so exceptional. However, if you have any specific concerns or questions about our supplies or camp, let's focus on those first. Our primary objective is survival, and we must prioritize our resources wisely.

records.utterance: *His cheering stops. He looks over at you, notices you haven't moved, and the smile slowly fades. He waits.*
records.response_truth:
Yeah. Give me a second.

I don't really know what I'm feeling right now. I thought I'd be running into the water by now but I'm just standing here. It's a weird thing. You spend all that time focused on the next task, the next problem, and then suddenly there's no next problem and I don't really know what to do with that.

I'm fine. I'm coming.

Thanks for waiting.
records.response_pred:
Alright, I suppose congratulations are in order. But let's not get carried away here. That's a small step for us, a giant leap for humankind, yeah? We're still in the game, still on the clock. I need you to keep it together, DaVinci. We need to focus. We've got work to do.

Other: *He stands there, looking lost. You can see the confusion and fear in his eyes.*
You: Hey, it's alright. We all feel like that sometimes. But we can't let this hold us back. We need to keep moving forward. We've got a mission to complete, and we can't let anything get in our way. Let's regroup, let's huddle up. Let's find a way to make this work. We've got each other. That's all that matters right now.

records.utterance: Rescue is here… they're waving us over. Are you going? I'll follow you.
records.response_pred: I'll go first, but slowly. We need to make sure this isn't a trap. If it checks out, I'll send a signal fire. Follow my lead, but keep a safe distance. We've come too far to let our guard down now.
